stories.title: Parc Adfer carbon capture plant approved despite doubts over 95% claim
stories.summary: Plans to capture carbon dioxide from the Parc Adfer waste plant on Deeside Industrial Park have been approved by Flintshire councillors. Enfinium wants to build a carbon capture plant next to its energy recovery facility off Weighbridge Road. stories.title: Ewloe 276-home plan deferred after notification letters mix-up
stories.summary: Decisions on 276 homes in Ewloe, a new Lidl supermarket in Broughton and an expansion at a Rhosesmor factory have all been put off. Flintshire Council’s planning committee deferred all three on Wednesday (4 November), before any debate. Officers had recommended approval for each one. stories.title: Police appeal to find man who missed Chester Crown Court sentencing
stories.summary: Police are appealing for help to find a 23-year-old man with links to Prestatyn who did not turn up at Chester Crown Court to be sentenced. stories.title: Saltney school closures: formal objection period opens until 1 December
stories.summary: People who want to object to plans to close Saltney Ferry and Saltney Wood Memorial primary schools have until 1 December to do so. Flintshire County Council published its statutory notice on the plans on 3 November, which opens a 28-day objection period.
